description: Which keyword words may NAME a column (measured word by word against live): 56 recovered words - types, clauses, DDL verbs, procedural and privilege words - declare in one table, select by name, and survive WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY; the five expression-leading words (case, cast, default, try_cast, when) define but cannot be referenced; the reserved words stay refused; TRUE/FALSE declare but a bare reference is the literal (qualifying reaches the column); ROLLUP/CUBE keep their keyword readings. Converted 1:1 from ddl/KeywordColumnNameTest (now retired).
